findings: Owner request 2026-11-09: practice long questions for Chapter 6 in the same format as the Physics chapter practice, long questions in the Biology Board shape (4 marks each) (English and Roman Urdu), written from the chapter; not printed in the book. 23 questions numbered 1-23; by section: u-atp-the-energy-currency-of-cells 1, u-photosynthesis-printed-as-5-1 1, u-role-of-photosynthetic-pigments 2, u-role-of-light 1, u-role-of-carbon-dioxide 1, u-mechanism-of-photosynthesis 3, u-chemiosmosis 1, u-2-light-independent-reactions 1, u-cellular-respiration-printed-as-5-2 1, u-mechanism-of-anaerobic-respiration 1, u-mechanism-of-aerobic-respiration 6, u-mechanism-of-photorespiration 1, u-disadvantages-of-photorespiration 1, u-adaptations-to-the-problems-of-photorespiration 2.

Covers ATP and the ATP-ADP cycle, compensation point, chlorophyll structure, accessory pigments, action spectrum, roles of light and CO₂, non-cyclic electron flow at PS-II and PS-I, cyclic vs non-cyclic flow, chemiosmosis in chloroplast and mitochondrion, Calvin cycle reduction and regeneration, cellular respiration, aerobic vs anaerobic respiration, both phases of glycolysis, pyruvic acid oxidation, Krebs cycle products, substrate-level vs chemiosmotic phosphorylation, ATP balance, photorespiration pathway and origin, CAM and C-4 vs CAM. The exercise's long questions are not repeated. Book corrections followed (van Niel, Z-scheme PS-II and PS-I, ATP and NADPH used in the Calvin reduction phase, fermentation equations and C₃H₆O₃, crassulacean acid metabolism, glycerate back to phosphoglycerate).
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
Drafts for the academic review (second-person review before publication).
